message: I often find myself thinking about how reliant we are on our phones and gadgets, especially during unexpected moments. There’s nothing quite like that sinking feeling when your device dies right when you need it most! 📱 It’s a good reminder to have some classic preparedness supplies on hand, just in case. After all, a little planning can go a long way in keeping our families safe and sound. What’s one thing you always make sure to have ready?
